review.method: Independent code, primary-source and public npm review by the parent and two research subagents; curated publication replaces unsupported statements in generated drafts.
corrections: Use the fixed 12–18 October npm window and exact observed counts; do not retain AGY ranges, unsupported stars or market-share claims.
Cloudflare deployment is Workers Static Assets; build-time force-static GET Route Handlers differ from a runtime backend.
AI SDK 7 is stable; package peers are declared compatibility, not integration acceptance in Aureform.
Current shadcn AI Elements patterns support Base UI; the earlier elements library announces deprecation at the end of November 2026.
Use structured UI-message parts and protocol mapping; native provider SSE is not automatically AI SDK UI-compatible.
OpenAI Assistants has closed; Responses tool loops require application handling. Google recommends @google/genai; the legacy npm name is @google/generative-ai despite a typo in the library table.
Langfuse AI SDK 7 uses registerTelemetry and @langfuse/vercel-ai-sdk, distinct from the v6 experimental_telemetry recipe.
Auth.js continues urgent/security maintenance after joining Better Auth; acquisition alone does not demonstrate another product is deprecated.
MapLibre, Google Maps opt-in, auth/Stripe seams and AI mock cancellation/retry already exist; distinguish extensions from newly delivered integrations.
SDK, server and hosted-service licenses differ. Current n8n FAQ allows certain organization-controlled predefined backend automations; do not use a blanket prohibition on commercial backends.
MCP current authorization specification is 2026-07-28; transport authorization is not a token vault, application authorization or sync engine.
Remove unmeasured bundle sizes, zero-cost promises, exact-runtime guarantees, fastest-growth/lowest-latency claims and universal provider quotas.
review.limitations: This is evidence synthesis, not customer interviews, a controlled adoption experiment, provider endorsement or production integration testing.

publicDataPolicy.included: CLI/version metadata, public search queries, exit/status evidence and SHA-256 of each original final response.
publicDataPolicy.excluded: Private configuration, credentials, project/session identifiers, thinking, provider event transcripts and unreviewed raw responses.
publicDataPolicy.responseDigestMeaning: The digest records the reviewed input draft. The draft itself is not distributed and its claims are not accepted merely because a hash exists.
